description: Search Estonia's e-Business Register (RIK open data) by the start of a company's current name, optionally filtered by registration status (registered, liquidation or bankrupt; any other value is refused, not ignored). Prefix match first ("Bolt" finds "Bolt Technology OÜ" but not "EuroBolt OÜ"); only when nothing starts with the text does it fall back to a weaker contains-the-text pass and report match_mode:'substring'; diacritic-insensitive, so plain-ASCII and Estonian spellings both work; the legal form is optional and can sit either side ("Tallinna Sadam", "Tallinna Sadam AS" and "AS Tallinna Sadam" all find "aktsiaselts TALLINNA SADAM"), and the company whose name matches exactly apart from its legal form is listed first. Use for "find Estonian companies named Bolt..." or to get a registry code to pass to ee_company.

name.description: Start of the company's current registered name, e.g. "Bolt".

status.description: Filter by registration status. "active" is a synonym for "registered". Case-insensitive; any other value is refused with the valid list.

name: ee_company_search
title: Ee Company Search
